_note: 2026-11-10 shoulder swap while CROUCHED (pad R3 hold 0.5 s). Run: python Source\tools\gametest\run.py --scenario-file Source\tools\gametest\scenarios_shoulder_crouch.json --scenarios shoulder_crouch --keep-pad. Start STANDING, Female V, UTPP camera on, third person, nothing drawn. Game in the foreground. Every step waits >= 4 s after a stance change (R3 presses inside the ~2 s stand<->crouch transition are swallowed by the game). Expected UTPP log lines per step are in the step names: swap = '[utpp_camera] shoulder -> left|right (pad)'; the reds side writes '[utpp_shoulder] R3 press seq=N stance=S' and '[utpp_shoulder] R3 release seq=N held=T holdComplete=0|1 timer=0|1 swapped=0|1 stance=S' (stance = PSM LocomotionDetailed, Stand 1 / Crouch 3). In 2.5 a 0.35 s R3 hold counts as a TAP for the game (toggles crouch), a 0.65 s hold does not toggle crouch.

shoulder_crouch.description: stand: settle | tap -> crouch | crouched hold 0.65 -> swap #1 | crouched hold 0.65 -> swap #2 | crouched hold 0.35 -> NO swap, V stands up | tap -> crouch | crouched hold 0.65 -> swap #3 | tap -> stand | standing hold 0.65 -> swap #4 (control)
